none: PAS KENT-040E03: Nummi or AE4 of the House of Constantine. Obverse view.
contea di ritrovamento: Kent (Inghilterra e Galles)

A complete, Roman, struck or hammered, nummi or AE4, copper coin of The House of Constantine, commemorative issue. Obverse: Laureate and cuirassed bust right. Inscription: Not applicable. Reverse: Two soldiers standing holding two standards. Inscription: [GLORIA EXERCITVS]. Die axis: 12 o'clock. The coin is in very fine, slightly worn condition but the flan is too small for the die and all the legend is missing. There is some pale green surface corrosion which goes around the slightly irregular edges. There also appears to be the remains of a silvery surface. This coin is likely to date between 330-335AD. Ref. Coins of England and the UK, Spink 2011, page 62 no. 599A and Identifying Roman…
